Mod.title: Girls' Frontline 2: Door Kickers
Mod.author: beanpuppy
Mod.description:
[h2]Girls' Frontline 2: Door Kickers[/h2] [code]Commander, you're here. Good.
We've been assigned operations in the contaminated zones. The areas are still unstable; Hostile forces have moved in, taken hostages, fortified positions. Someone needs to clear them out.
I know it's dangerous work, but... we'll be careful. Just give us the orders and we'll see it through.
What do you say, Commander?[/code]
[h3]Overview[/h3] This mod brings tactical dolls from Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium into Door Kickers 2 as fully playable units. Each doll has their 3D model converted from the original game, along with their signature weapon, and voice lines.
Every weapon has been individually tuned and each weapon class plays differently. Dolls also come with custom armour, helmets, and alternative ammo types, with new equipment being added regularly.
Some dolls have alternate costumes available. This requires the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3286103408]In-Game Camouflage Selector[/url] mod loaded before this mod. Without the camo selector mod, dolls will use their default outfit.
[h3]Units[/h3] [b]Task Force DEFY:[/b] Alva, Voymastina [b]H.I.D.E 404:[/b] Klukai, Mechty, Andoris, Belka, Leva, Lenna, Vector [b]Zucchero Café:[/b] Springfield, Makiatto, Centaureissi, Sharkry [b]Groza Squad:[/b] Groza, Nemesis, Krolik, Colphne, Vepley [b]Elmo Combined Echelon:[/b] Peritya, Sabrina, Qiuhua, Peri, Florence, Nikketa, Helen, Lewis [b]Frostfall Squad:[/b] Qiongju, Cheeta, Tololo, Lind [b]Monsoon Squad:[/b] Daiyan, Jiangyu, Zhaohui, Faye [b]POL-03 Security Division:[/b] Mosin-Nagant, Nagant, Ksenia, Papasha
[i]Note: Only dolls currently available in GFL2 are/will be included.[/i]
To see our roadmap, visit the [url=https://trello.com/b/y77gdE1R/girl-kickers]Trello board.[/url] Contribute on [url=https://github.com/antistrategie/girl-kickers]GitHub[/url] or join the [url=https://discord.gg/XcfYGmxvde]Discord[/url] for discussion and feedback.
[h3]Known Limitations[/h3] DK2 expects uniform model sizes, so dolls with unusual heights or builds may have minor visual issues. Models are optimised for the default top-down view and any issues only visible in freelook are expected.
[h3]Credits[/h3] Contributors: [list] [*] beanpuppy [*] Setlys [*] Housenflou [*] MistressAshai [*] Charlie Sparky [/list] Special thanks to: [list] [*] MICA Team - Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium [*] kenji1997 - AssetStudio fork for model extraction [*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/luwiss96/]Luwis96[/url] - Commissioned some early weapon UI images [*] Everyone giving suggestions and reporting bugs [/list]
[h3]Community Patches:[/h3] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3586738239]Chinese localisation[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3595646925]Korean localisation[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3605426442]Japanese localisation[/url] [/list]
Mod.changeNotes:
Notice
To prepare for the rework of the combined Girl unit, we're testing a web-based unit builder at https://antistrategie.github.io/girl-kickers/unit-builder/ where you can build custom squads, customise stats, and download as a ready-to-play mod to install. It's still early so we'd appreciate any feedback before the Girl unit rework lands.
We've also opened up our Discord server to the public for general discussion, feedback, and mod news. If you try the unit builder, we'd love to hear your thoughts there: https://discord.gg/XcfYGmxvde
This update also includes additional costumes for dolls (see change-log for specifics). To use them you need to have the "In-Game Camouflage Selector" mod installed and enabled BEFORE this mod. Note that this addition required changing how models work in the mod so you will need to remake your units or else the models won't show up in-game (regardless of if you're using the camo selector mod).
---
Added POL-03 Security Division as a new unit. Added Lockpick action waypoint for locked doors. Various localisation updates to better reflect mod mechanics. Polished/cleaned up several doll and weapon models. Reduced doll texture resolution from 4K to 2K, cutting mod size by roughly 2 GB with no visible difference in-game. Don't ask why they were 4K in the first place >:[
Balance changes: - Rebalanced all doll firing profiles for more consistent TTK. - Reduced doll movement speed slightly to allow more natural target engagement without constant stop-and-shoot. - Increased doll suppression resistance. - Reworked scopes.
Added costumes: - Makiatto: Ballroom Interlude - Klukai: Speed Star, Astral Luminous - Vector: Vivi Sometimes Hides Her Molotovs - Leva: Diamond Flower - Springfield: Queen in Radiance, Enjoy the Fragrance - Alva: Antje - Voymastina: Erwin - Mosin-Nagant: Siberian Slide - Groza: Dawn of Battle - Tololo: Horizon Cruise - Peritya: Born Huntress
